description: Golden parity for billing.getBillingConfig's gating predicate: isBillingConfigured(env) — true ONLY when the Stripe secret key AND both self-serve price ids are present (non-empty). Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS export packages/api/src/lib/stripe.ts (mapping these neutral keys to STRIPE_SECRET_KEY / STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER / STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL) and the C# Tims.Domain.Billing.StripeBillingConfig.IsConfigured. Fail-CLOSED: any missing or empty-string value -> not configured (never a fabricated checkout URL).
